content:
incident-bot: P1 alert — PrivateLink DNS failures detected in eu-central-1b. Customers impacted: acme-corp, beta-ml. Paging @sre-oncall-tue.

sre-oncall-tue: on it. seeing spike in DNS NXDOMAIN from resolver pool eu-c-1b. starting triage.

maria-net: looking at VPC endpoints and resolver rules now. any recent deploys to networking?

alex-sre: no infra deploys in the window. checking metrics: DNS error rate jumped ~65% at 09:11 UTC. Route53 private resolver logs show timeouts to ENI IPs behind privatelink endpoints.

ken-cs: pinged acme. they report app errors and fallback to public endpoints failed. they have retry logic but saturating. customer impact: high for two customers, outage-level.

raj-eng: pulling traceroutes from multiple regions to the endpoint IPs. here's a sample: ```traceroute -n 10.0.45.23
 1 10.0.1.1 0.5 ms
 2 10.0.12.4 1.2 ms
 3 * * *
``` looks like ENI not responding.

maria-net: ENI flap in eu-central-1b, AZ-level network control-plane showing transient detach events. correlating with noisy maintenance job on host pool. tagging as probable root.

alex-sre: mitigation suggestion: fail traffic from eu-central-1b resolver pool to eu-central-1a by updating resolver rule priority to prefer cross-AZ resolver target. Do we have capacity for cross-AZ?

maria-net: we can shift resolver TTLs and update route priority. Short term: update resolver rules to point to healthy ENIs in eu-central-1a, and restart private endpoint NLB in 1b to force reattachment.

sre-oncall-tue: performing NLB restart for privatelink endpoint id pls-0a12b3c4 in eu-c-1b. command: ```aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn arn:... --attributes Key=deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds,Value=10``` then drain/re-register.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook step 4 triggered: "If PrivateLink ENI unresponsive, restart NLB target and re-register ENIs. Notify CS and monitor DNS logs for <5m recovery."

ken-cs: notified acme + beta-ml that we're applying mitigation and will update in 10m. they asked for IP-level failover guidance if needed.

alex-sre: NLB restart complete. seeing re-registration events for ENIs. DNS NXDOMAIN rate dropping to ~12%. continuing to monitor.

raj-eng: verifying application level: acme's failed calls reduced from 300/m to 4/m in last 5m. beta-ml also recovering.

maria-net: root cause: noisy host maintenance kicked network agent that periodically detached ENIs from privatelink target group in a single AZ. Fix: block that maintenance window for hosts with privatelink ENIs and roll config to avoid aggressive detach on network agent restart.

sre-oncall-tue: marking incident as mitigated. creating follow-up ticket to track permanent fix and change control: NET-1452. assigning to @maria-net for remediation and to @raj-eng for test harness.

ken-cs: updated customers: acme and beta-ml confirmed service restored. they asked for CC on NET-1452.

alex-sre: handoff to next oncall (sre-oncall-wed) at 10:00 UTC. brief summary for handoff: "PrivateLink DNS failures eu-central-1b caused by ENI detach during host maintenance; temporary mitigation was NLB restart and resolver rule failover to eu-c-1a; monitoring shows stable; follow-up NET-1452 to prevent host maintenance on privatelink hosts and add automated alert if ENI detaches >2 in 5m."

sre-oncall-tue: handing off. link to incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NET-1452. oncall notes in the ticket. ping me if it reoccurs. :thumbsup:
